scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Write and validate a compact partitioned round trip
cases.input_contract: Repartition source by day into 2 execution partitions, write Parquet with error-if-exists and partitionBy(day), then read it back. Compare field types and the complete duplicate-sensitive bag.
cases.expected: 2000 rows and total 13993000 survive. Types remain id/amount bigints and day/payload strings;read nullability may differ.
cases.verification: Assert type mapping and exceptAll emptiness in both directions, plus row count and amount total.

cases.title: Read a narrow filtered projection with an independent oracle
cases.input_contract: Select only id and amount for day=even and id>=1990. Return the five ordered tuples.
cases.verification: Assert every projected identity and amount and exact two-column output schema.

cases.title: Locate partition, column and predicate evidence in the scan
cases.input_contract: Capture a FORMATTED plan for the selected query on the owned Parquet view. Extract ReadSchema, PartitionFilters and PushedFilters lines and interpret each scope.
cases.expected: ReadSchema has id and amount but not payload;PartitionFilters mentions day/even;PushedFilters includes the id lower bound.
cases.verification: Assert the relevant field/predicate markers and retain the exact five-row output oracle;do not claim bytes skipped from the plan alone.

cases.title: Compare a deliberately larger file count without changing data
cases.input_contract: Write the same source after repartition 12 using the same day directory partitioning. Inventory only.parquet data files and their actual byte sizes for both layouts.
cases.expected: Both round trips match the source bag. The many layout has more data files than compact;both byte totals are positive and below 32 MiB.
cases.verification: Assert bag parity, file-count inequality and measured data-byte bounds. Ignore checksum and success-marker files in data counts.

cases.title: Report storage partitions, files and scan partitions separately
cases.input_contract: Return a receipt with the number of day= directories, the data-file count and the read DataFrame execution-partition count for each layout.
cases.expected: Both layouts have 2 day directories. Data-file counts are the measured inventory values. Scan partitions are positive observed values and need not equal either other count.
cases.verification: Assert two directory partitions and independent file-count consistency;print actual scan partition counts without imposing equality.

cases.title: Reject an existing target and preserve its product
cases.input_contract: Attempt a second error-if-exists write to the already owned compact path. Require the expected analysis error, then read the original product and reconcile its bag.
cases.expected: The second write fails with an existing-path analysis exception;the original 2000-row product remains unchanged.
cases.verification: Assert the exception and full original bag after the failed write. Do not delete or overwrite the target to make the retry succeed.

golden.scope: Fresh owned root beneath current job with compact/many children;finally removes only that root.
